name: Cheech & Chong - 2g Disposable Vapes - Snow Cake
description:
Sweet, creamy, and smooth as it gets. The Cheech & Chong Snow Cake disposable packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Snow Cake brings a rich, dessert-forward profile: sweet vanilla cake and frosting notes up front, layered with a cool, crisp edge and a smooth, buttery finish. It's an indulgent, easygoing flavor made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet and effortlessly smooth.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Snow Cake flavor — sweet vanilla cake and frosting with a cool, crisp edge
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Rich flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Snow Cake is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
